outcomes.description: Change the DVD from black to white.

nodes.question: Does the same DVD object from the source image appear white in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Track the source DVD—a small rectangular case/disc near the center of the source image—into the edited image using its location and distinctive shape/appearance. Complete only if that same object is clearly identifiable in the edited image and is white. Partial if the same object is clearly identifiable and has changed from black toward white but is not white. Absent if the same object is clearly identifiable and remains black with no requested change. Unknown if its identity or correspondence is unclear, it is missing, or evidence is insufficient; do not substitute another newly visible disc.
nodes.binding: Target: the small rectangular DVD case/disc near the center of the source image. Reference: the same source object, tracked into the edited image by location and distinctive appearance; assess its color only when correspondence is clear.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
